narrative.overview: LightFix puts the resident's next action and each repair status in plain view. White working surfaces, a pale green canvas, dark text, and measured gold accents support quick reporting on a phone and dense staff work on larger screens. The only logo symbol is a yellow outline lightbulb. The LightFix name is separate text in the header and elsewhere; do not combine it with the mark into logo artwork. Thai-first labels, visible status words, and familiar controls carry the experience.
keyCharacteristics: A single-column reporting flow at phone width, with the pole number first.
White header and surfaces over a pale green canvas; gold marks primary actions and selected controls.
Textual status badges and compact, readable records.
Staff navigation as a select on mobile and a rail from desktop width.

rules.name: The Selective Gold Rule
rules.body: Reserve gold for the brand mark, primary action, selected control, and small progress cues; keep routine copy in ink.

rules.name: The Identifier First Rule
rules.body: Make the pole number and status easy to find before secondary detail.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Use lines and white surfaces to organize routine work; apply shadows to transient or interactive states.

dos: Do place the pole number first in the public report flow and use one clear gold submit action.
Do keep status words visible alongside status color.
Do use the yellow outline bulb as the sole logo symbol and render LightFix as separate text.
Do keep staff controls usable in labeled mobile cards and a compact desktop table.
donts: Don't merge the word LightFix into the bulb logo artwork or replace the outline bulb with a filled mark.
Don't rely on color alone for progress, selection, or errors.
Don't make mobile data depend on an unlabeled wide table.
